device_endpoints.sparql:
PREFIX ecad: <https://example.org/ecad/>
SELECT DISTINCT * WHERE { GRAPH ?graph { ?device ecad:hasAssetIdentifier ?asset . FILTER(isLiteral(?asset) && STR(?asset) = "https://aas.example.com/FI106") ?device ecad:hasConnectionPoints ?device_collection . ?device_collection ecad:hasEndPoint ?device_endpoint . } } LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT * WHERE { GRAPH ?graph { ?device ecad:hasAssetIdentifier ?asset . FILTER(isLiteral(?asset) && STR(?asset) = "https://aas.example.com/FI106") ?device ecad:hasConnectionPoints ?device_collection . ?device_collection ecad:hasEndPoint ?device_endpoint . ?plc_collection ecad:hasPLCEndPoint ?plc_endpoint . { { ?device_endpoint ?connecting_predicate ?plc_endpoint . } UNION { ?plc_endpoint ?connecting_predicate ?device_endpoint . } } } } LIMIT 200

shared_intermediate.sparql:
PREFIX ecad: <https://example.org/ecad/>
SELECT DISTINCT * WHERE { GRAPH ?graph { ?device ecad:hasAssetIdentifier ?asset . FILTER(isLiteral(?asset) && STR(?asset) = "https://aas.example.com/FI106") ?device ecad:hasConnectionPoints ?device_collection . ?device_collection ecad:hasEndPoint ?device_endpoint . ?plc_collection ecad:hasPLCEndPoint ?plc_endpoint . ?device_endpoint ?device_edge ?intermediate . ?plc_endpoint ?plc_edge ?intermediate . FILTER(isIRI(?intermediate)) } } LIMIT 200

limitations: Direct/shared-resource candidate edges require predicate-level engineering review.
Shared intermediate resource is not automatically an electrical connection.
A zero-row probe is not proof of absence; results may be limited or graph-scoped.
PLC endpoint association is not inferred from matching labels, identifiers, or positions.
No GraphDB writes or installation/BOM/containment inference.
